hypothesis: The current heads appear more compressible as pinned HC base plus narrow Transcendence overrides/deletions than the older exact experiment subjects.
A new exact reconstruction experiment may require only eight target overrides plus a 37-path deletion/exclusion manifest, but this has not yet been executed or qualified.
